contact_reasons.description: Why the customer made contact. 1-3 per call, exactly one primary.

fees_and_charges.label: Fees and charges
fees_and_charges.definition: Unexpected, increased or disputed fees, interest or penalties.
examples: annual fee charged after a promised waiver
overdraft fee after a deposit hold

unauthorized_or_fraud.label: Unauthorized activity or fraud
unauthorized_or_fraud.definition: Transactions, accounts or transfers the customer did not authorise; scams.

dispute_or_chargeback.label: Dispute or chargeback
dispute_or_chargeback.definition: Disputing a merchant transaction or how a dispute was handled.

payment_or_transfer_problem.label: Payment or transfer problem
payment_or_transfer_problem.definition: Payment, deposit or transfer late, lost, reversed or misapplied.

funds_hold_or_account_restriction.label: Funds hold or account restriction
funds_hold_or_account_restriction.definition: Deposit holds, frozen, locked or restricted accounts.

access_or_digital_banking.label: Access or digital banking
access_or_digital_banking.definition: Login, lockout, app or online banking failures, card activation or unexplained declines.
examples: debit card declined at every store

account_opening_or_closure.label: Account opening or closure
account_opening_or_closure.definition: Opening, closing, denied opening, or closed by the bank.

balance_or_statement_error.label: Balance or statement error
balance_or_statement_error.definition: Wrong balance, missing transactions, statement errors.

loan_servicing.label: Loan servicing
loan_servicing.definition: Mortgage, auto, student or personal loan payments, escrow, modification, payoff, forbearance.

credit_decision_or_limit.label: Credit decision or limit
credit_decision_or_limit.definition: Application denied, limit reduced, or the terms of credit offered.

credit_reporting.label: Credit reporting
credit_reporting.definition: Incorrect reporting to credit bureaus, inquiries, disputes with the furnisher.

collections_or_debt.label: Collections or debt
collections_or_debt.definition: Collection contacts, debt not owed, wrong amount.

customer_service_experience.label: Customer service experience
customer_service_experience.definition: Waits, no callback, transfers, rudeness, broken promises.

terms_information_or_communication.label: Terms, information or communication
terms_information_or_communication.definition: Unclear or changed terms, missing notices, misleading marketing, how-to or status questions.

rewards_or_promotions.label: Rewards or promotions
rewards_or_promotions.definition: Points, cash back, sign-up bonuses, promotional rates.

other_or_unclear.label: Other or unclear
other_or_unclear.definition: Abstention: nothing above fits or the text is too redacted to tell.

products.description: Products mentioned in the text. 1-3 per call.

checking_or_savings.label: Checking or savings
checking_or_savings.definition: Deposit accounts, debit cards, ATM, direct deposit.

credit_card.label: Credit card
credit_card.definition: Credit and charge cards, including store cards.

personal_loan.label: Personal loan
personal_loan.definition: Personal, payday, title or advance loans and lines of credit.

money_transfer_or_p2p.label: Money transfer or P2P
money_transfer_or_p2p.definition: Zelle, wires, remittances, money orders, cashier's checks, virtual currency.

debt_collection.label: Debt collection
debt_collection.definition: Collection of a debt by the bank or a collector.

services.description: Where the experience happened, across products. 0-3 per call.

driver_categories.description: What specifically caused the feeling about a topic. One per topic.

unexpected_charge.label: Unexpected charge
unexpected_charge.definition: A fee, interest or amount the customer did not expect or agree to.

money_held_or_not_returned.label: Money held or not returned
money_held_or_not_returned.definition: Funds held, frozen, delayed or not refunded.

no_response_or_follow_up.label: No response or follow-up
no_response_or_follow_up.definition: Promised callbacks, updates or replies that never came.

long_wait_or_delay.label: Long wait or delay
long_wait_or_delay.definition: Hold times, slow processing, repeated delays.

incorrect_or_conflicting_information.label: Incorrect or conflicting information
incorrect_or_conflicting_information.definition: Wrong or contradictory answers from the bank.

denied_or_declined_without_explanation.label: Denied or declined without explanation
denied_or_declined_without_explanation.definition: A request, claim, application or transaction refused with no usable reason.

system_or_app_failure.label: System or app failure
system_or_app_failure.definition: App, website, ATM or card system not working.

fraud_not_stopped_or_not_refunded.label: Fraud not stopped or not refunded
fraud_not_stopped_or_not_refunded.definition: The bank did not prevent, stop or reimburse fraud or a scam.

policy_or_terms_change.label: Policy or terms change
policy_or_terms_change.definition: Terms, rates, limits or policies changed on the customer.

repeated_contact_needed.label: Repeated contact needed
repeated_contact_needed.definition: The customer had to call, write or visit many times.

error_not_corrected.label: Error not corrected
error_not_corrected.definition: A known mistake that the bank did not fix.

helpful_staff.label: Helpful staff
helpful_staff.definition: Staff went out of their way or were kind and competent.

fair_outcome.label: Fair outcome
fair_outcome.definition: A refund, reversal or decision the customer found fair.

other_or_unclear.label: Other or unclear
other_or_unclear.definition: Abstention: the trigger is not identifiable.

customer_asks.description: What the customer says they want to happen.

-2.label: Angry
-2.definition: Furious, threatens to leave or go to a regulator.
